description: Bare-metal variant naming. e.g. i3.metal, m5.metal. Distinguishes from non-bare-metal members of the same family.
Default established-TCP-connection idle timeout. Reduced from 432,000s to 350s in Nitro v6 — apps relying on long-idle connections must implement keepalives.
Per-network-card max bandwidth ceiling. Actual instance throughput may be lower; check per-instance specs.
Operational consideration: account for up to 20 minutes from 'running' to 'network-reachable' on bare-metal launches. Tune ASG / orchestrator timeouts accordingly.

default_value: present on bare-metal + select Nitro v6 instances
description: Required CPU feature for nested KVM (running Firecracker / KVM / VMware as a guest). Bare-metal: always present. Virtualized Nitro: present only on C8i/M8i/R8i (with ~10% overhead).
